description: Use for a fast sellability/honeypot check ("can I sell this token?"): simulated buy/sell and tax on EVM; live Jupiter sell quote plus freeze/mint authority and token-2022 transfer controls on Solana; 0-100 risk score. For a full rug and safety report (authority, holders, liquidity, creator warnings), use rug_check. For USD price and 24h change, use token_price. $0.01 per check. If chain is omitted, Solana mints default to solana and 0x addresses default to base. The /rugradar website gives 1 free check every day per visitor; this MCP tool is paid. Invalid or failed calls are not charged (a used credit is refunded). With no usable credit key, the tool returns error=payment_required and the x402 Payment Required challenge for its HTTP route; pay that USDC amount, then retry the URL.

api_key.description: optional RugRadar credit key (or send header X-RugRadar-Key)

chain.description: Omit to default: solana for Solana mints, base for 0x addresses. Allowed: solana, base, bnb, ethereum, arbitrum

token.description: Solana mint or EVM 0x token contract

name: honeypot_check

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

buyerSummary.description: Buyer-facing summary of the overall report

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

facts.description: Named safety fields (authority, holders, liquidity, age, and related public facts)

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

tensionLine.description: One short token-specific danger line (max 140 chars) that leads the result; null when nothing is flagged

title: Honeypot / Can I Sell Check
